Question 8

Consider the differential equation dydx+2xy=sin⁡xx,x>0. Select the correct options below. An integrating factor for this equation is I(x)=
 
x2
2x
ex2
e2/x
.

The general solution is given by y(x)=
 
sin⁡xx+cos⁡xx2+Cx2
sin⁡xx2−cos⁡xx+Cx2
sin⁡xx−cos⁡xx2+Cx
sin⁡xx2+cos⁡xx+Cx
.
